trigger: The first paid execution attempt failed closed before authorization consumption or provider mutation because the 120-minute profile reservation could exceed the stage target spend at the profile maximum hourly rate.
rationale: Eighty minutes covers the prospectively estimated 20-to-60-minute checkpoint download and one-interaction canary window while keeping the reservation below the stage target even at the profile's maximum admitted hourly rate.
failure_rule: If the canary cannot finish inside 4800 seconds, teardown and retain the timeout as a runtime failure; do not extend the TTL or rerun without a new prospective amendment.
claim_boundary: The shorter TTL changes no scientific input and earns no WAM, ranking, transfer, economics, physical-success, or thesis credit.
